genPrompt:
COPY-AD REMAKE. The FIRST attached image is a proven, high-spending competitor Facebook ad. Recreate it as a NEAR-IDENTICAL remake for LACALUT White & Repair (German pharmacy oral care). Target: a viewer who saw both would say "same ad, different brand". KEEP EXACTLY (do not reinterpret, improve, re-compose or add to): the layout grid and every zone's position and size, the background, scene, props, people, poses, crops, camera angle, lighting, colour-blocking, type hierarchy, type sizes, text positions, alignment, badges, arrows, stickers, borders and overall finish. If it is a flat graphic, stay flat; if it is a photo, stay photographic; if it is UGC / lo-fi, stay lo-fi. BACKGROUND COLOUR — MANDATORY CHANGE (the ONE thing that is ALWAYS different from the reference): replace the reference's dominant background / card colour with light silver-grey #E9EBEE to platinum grey #D9DCE1 (LACALUT White & Repair brand grey) — NEVER green, sage, blue or cream. Keep the same background TYPE (flat card stays a flat card, gradient stays a gradient, photo scene stays a photo scene with its surfaces re-tinted toward this colour), same texture and lighting — only the hue changes. Re-tint any panel borders, pills or outlines that matched the old background so they still sit naturally on the new one. Text colours stay as the reference unless contrast fails, then darken/lighten minimally. SWAP ONLY: (a) their product → the attached LACALUT reference packshot, placed in the SAME spot, SAME scale, SAME angle and SAME lighting as their product (if their product is held, ours is held the same way); (b) their brand name, logo and wording → the LACALUT wording below. Where a line is marked "keep", reproduce it exactly; where it is rewritten, keep the SAME size, weight, colour, case and position for the new words. 

PRODUCTION SPEC OF THE REFERENCE AD (follow literally — this is the layout and copy to rebuild):
1. CANVAS
1.1. Aspect ratio: Approximately 9:16 (tall portrait).
1.2. Overall style: Hybrid of product photography and flat graphic design, featuring before-and-after close-up photos of teeth, a product shot, and prominent text elements.
1.3. Dominant background: Solid light grey-white.

2. LAYOUT GRID
2.1. Headline band top 15% of height.
2.2. Before/After image split middle 45% of height.
2.3. Descriptive text for Before/After lower middle 15% of height.
2.4. Product, brand, and review elements bottom 25% of height.

3. TEXT

3.2. "BEFORE" – Top left of the before-and-after image, medium, bold, all caps, black, sans bold font style, left aligned, on a white rectangular background pill.
3.3. "AFTER" – Top right of the before-and-after image, medium, bold, all caps, black, sans bold font style, right aligned, on a white rectangular background pill.
3.4. "Visible coffee stains" – Bottom left below the "BEFORE" image, small, regular, title case, dark grey, sans font style, left aligned, no background.
3.5. "Thinning enamel" – Below "Visible coffee stains", small, regular, title case, dark grey, sans font style, left aligned, no background.
3.6. "Sensitivity" – Below "Thinning enamel", small, regular, title case, dark grey, sans font style, left aligned, no background.
3.7. "Dissolved stains" – Bottom right below the "AFTER" image, small, regular, title case, dark grey, sans font style, right aligned, no background.
3.8. "Remineralised enamel" – Below "Dissolved stains", small, regular, title case, dark grey, sans font style, right aligned, no background.
3.9. "Reduction in sensitivity" – Below "Remineralised enamel", small, regular, title case, dark grey, sans font style, right aligned, no background.
3.10. "Original Mint" – On the toothpaste tube, small, regular, title case, white, handwritten font style, centered, on a mint green oval badge.
3.11. "ZING." – Vertically oriented on the toothpaste tube, large, bold, all caps, white, sans bold font style, left aligned relative to tube, no background.
3.12. "TOOTHPASTE" – Vertically oriented on the toothpaste tube, small, regular, all caps, white, sans font style, right aligned relative to tube, no background.
3.13. "ZING." – Bottom left, huge, bold, all caps, black, sans bold font style, left aligned, no background.
3.14. "Loved by 103,748 UK customers" – Below the stars, small, regular, title case, dark grey, sans font style, left aligned, no background. The number "103,748" is bolded and black.

4. PRODUCT
4.1. What it is: A toothpaste tube.
4.2. Where it sits: Bottom left zone, positioned vertically.
4.3. Approx % of canvas height: Approximately 22% of the canvas height.
4.4. Angle: Standing upright, slightly tilted to the right.
4.5. Lighting: Soft, even studio lighting, highlighting the tube's texture.
4.6. Shadow/reflection: A subtle, soft shadow is cast directly beneath the tube.
4.7. Held or standing: Standing.

5. PEOPLE / PROPS / SCENE
5.1. Who/what: Close-up macro photographs of human teeth and gums.
5.2. Pose: Static, showing the front surface of two central incisors and parts of adjacent teeth.
5.3. Expression: N/A (teeth only).
5.4. Crop: The images are tightly cropped to focus on the teeth, with the gum line visible at the top of the frame.
5.5. Props: None.
5.6. Camera angle and lens feel: Direct, slightly downward-angled macro shot, with a shallow depth of field that keeps the tooth surface sharp.

6. GRAPHIC DEVICES
6.1. Diagonal split: A thick, solid black diagonal line divides the before-and-after images, running from the top-left to the bottom-right of the image section.
6.2. Stars: Five solid green star icons are positioned below the large "ZING." text at the bottom, arranged horizontally.
6.3. Badge: A small, oval-shaped mint green badge with white text "Original Mint" is on the upper part of the toothpaste tube.

7. COLOUR PALETTE
7.1. #F5F7F8: Dominant background color (light grey-white).
7.2. #000000: Main text elements ("This toothpaste uses liquid enamel.", large "ZING.", "BEFORE", "AFTER", diagonal split line, bolded "103,748").
7.3. #333333: Smaller descriptive text (e.g., "Visible coffee stains", "Loved by... UK customers").
7.4. #6EE0C7: Primary color of the toothpaste tube body.
7.5. #4CAF50: Color of the five star icons and the "Original Mint" badge text.
7.6. #FFFFFF: Color of the toothpaste tube cap, "BEFORE" and "AFTER" text backgrounds, and text on the toothpaste tube.

8. MOOD / FINISH
8.1. Lighting: Bright, clean, and clinical, with even illumination across the teeth photos and product shot.
8.2. Contrast: High contrast for text elements against the light background; moderate contrast within the teeth photographs to highlight differences.
8.3. Photo vs render: The teeth are clearly photographs. The toothpaste tube appears to be a high-quality product photograph or a realistic 3D render.
8.4. Any filter or grain: No discernible filter or grain; the overall finish is sharp, smooth, and clean.
